findings.title: After an edit closes, keyboard focus lands on an invisible button with no focus ring.
findings.body: `focus({ focusVisible: false })` runs for every edit close, including keyboard ones. A keyboard user who opens the edit composer and presses Escape or Enter gets focus back on the card's ⋯ button with no focus ring. The same PR changed comments.css so the actions show only on `:hover` or `:has(:focus-visible)`, not `:focus-within`, so that button also stays at `opacity: 0`. The user is then focused on an element they cannot see, which is an accessibility regression. Fix: suppress the focus ring only when the edit was closed with the pointer. For example, record whether the closing action came from a pointer event and pass `focusVisible: false` only in that case.
